WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry AS Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price,
         avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM invoice_averages
),
scored AS (
  SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation,
         deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS adjusted_deviation
  FROM deviations
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, adjusted_deviation
FROM scored
ORDER BY adjusted_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT (SELECT 10 + COUNT(*) FROM scored
       WHERE adjusted_deviation = (
         SELECT adjusted_deviation FROM scored
         ORDER BY adjusted_deviation DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
       ))
